subject: Request: Conditional Net-90 + usage credit proposal for Meridian Systems
messages:
From: Alexandra Soto <alex.soto@meridian-systems.com>
To: irene_choi@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 10 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: billing cadence + extended payment window for FY28

Irene —

Thanks again for the demo last week. Meridian is preparing the FY28 procurement calendar and procurement has asked if we can move our billing to quarterly invoices and an extended payment window (Net-90) for the first 12 months. This is a firm requirement for our internal cashflow timing — otherwise the contract needs to be pushed to the next quarter.

To be clear: they are asking for quarterly invoicing with Net-90 for each invoice. They expect normal T&Cs otherwise. Is there a way to accommodate this for a pilot year? We’re targeting a June 1 start.

I can loop in our procurement lead if helpful (procurement@meridian-systems.com).

Thanks,
Alexandra Soto
Head of Cloud Procurement
Meridian Systems

Attachment: Meridian_MA-request-terms.pdf (pdf stub)

From: irene_choi@redwood.ai
To: Alexandra Soto <alex.soto@meridian-systems.com>
Cc: jonas_weber@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 10 May 2027 09:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: billing cadence + extended payment window for FY28

Alexandra —

Appreciate the clarity. I can make a proposal back to procurement but need approval from Finance/Deal Desk for Net-90 and quarterly invoicing. If we grant Net-90 for the first 12 months, Commercial would like to offset credit/risk — two approaches that could work:

- Provide a one-time usage credit equal to 6% of the first-year committed spend (applied as invoice credit over the first two quarters)
- Or require a partial prepay covering month 1 (or 25% of Q1) in exchange for Net-90 on the remaining invoices

Could you confirm if a usage credit (applied as a credit schedule) would be acceptable, or whether Meridian requires no up-front payment? I’ll loop in Jonas and Marissa for approval consideration and ship a formal conditional term sheet.

Best,
Irene Choi
Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference

Attachment: invoice_schedule_proposal.xlsx (xlsx stub)

From: jonas_weber@redwood.ai
To: irene_choi@redwood.ai
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 11 May 2027 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Meridian request — recommendation for approval

Irene —

Read the ask. Commercial risk on Net-90 is moderate given Meridian’s size and usage profile but acceptable with mitigations. Recommendation for Executive approval:

1) Approve Net-90 for a 12-month pilot with quarterly invoicing.
2) Apply a usage credit equal to 6% of the first-year committed ARR, disbursed as invoice credits across the first two quarterly invoices.
3) Require standard credit review (AR hold triggers) — if any invoice ages >120 days, rights to revert to Net-30 for remainder of term.

Rationale: preserves initial cashflow for Meridian, limits Redwood exposure, and keeps the deal competitive. Please capture this in the term sheet.

Jonas
VP, Revenue Operations

Date: Wed, 12 May 2027 08:27:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Meridian request — recommendation for approval

Agree with Jonas. Small tweak: set the credit to be refundable only via invoice credits (not cash), and include a clause requiring a 30-day notice before reverting terms at renewal. Also recommend a clause that limits credit to the committed usage band (protects us from under-consumption).

I’ll draft the conditional term sheet language and mark it for exec sign-off:
- Net-90 (12 months)
- Quarterly invoicing
- 6% first-year usage credit applied as invoice credits to Q1/Q2 invoices
- Reversion rights if invoices age >120 days or usage drops 30% below committed band

Marissa Cole
Director, Deal Desk

Cc: jonas_weber@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai, procurement@meridian-systems.com
Date: Thu, 13 May 2027 16:40:00 -07:00
Subject: Conditional approval granted — Meridian Systems pilot terms

Alexandra —

Thank you for the quick turnaround. Executive approval has been granted on a conditional basis. Summary of the approved pilot terms you can share with Procurement: 

- Billing cadence: Quarterly invoicing for the pilot year (4 invoices).
- Payment terms: Net-90 on each quarterly invoice for 12 months.
- Commercial offset: 6% of first-year committed spend issued as invoice credits split across Q1 and Q2 invoices (credit only, not cash).
- Protections for Redwood: If any invoice ages beyond 120 days from invoice date, Redwood reserves the right to convert remaining invoices to Net-30 and/or place an AR hold until payments are current.
- Usage band clause: credit applies only if consumption remains within the committed usage band; significant under-consumption (>=30% below committed) will void the credit for subsequent quarters.

Next steps: Marissa will send a redline to the master agreement with the conditional term language and an updated exhibit that captures the invoice credit schedule. Can you confirm Meridian’s committed ARR so we can calculate the 6% credit amount and produce the Q1/Q2 credit entries?

If Procurement needs a named exec approver for their records, Jonas Weber (VP, Revenue Ops) authorized the exception on behalf of Revenue.

Best regards,
Irene Choi
Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference

Attachments: Meridian_MA-v3_redline.pdf, invoice_schedule_proposal.xlsx
